about: Hand-written vectors for membership.py (design M1-M12 and the cases around them). A scenario is told run by run: a run gives each instrument an outcome [key, outcome, rank, price]; events are the transitions worth recording in the order given (entries best ranked first); waiting and blocked name the matches that could not be added; rows are partial expectations (null: no row); sync reads the list, applies the plan and reads it again, as the service does. A time is HH:MM on the scenario's day.

scenarios.note: not a member, hit: ENTERED, first seen now, one hit; the sync adds it
a miss or a gap on something that is not a member leaves no row at all
member: hit, miss, miss with a grace of 2 runs is STILL, MISSING 1, EXITED, then removed from the list

steps.note: still wanted: a missed run is not an exit

scenarios.note: missing 1, then a hit: active again with no misses, and nothing to tell
exited at 10:45, hit at 11:30: entered again, entries 2, a new stay, added again
pinned, five misses: it stays, and the row still says when it last matched

steps.note: a pinned row is never removed

scenarios.note: the owner removed it from the list and it still matches: dismissed, not added again; after it has exited and enters again it is added again
a hit in between keeps a removed instrument out: the grace has to run its whole length

steps.note: it never left the screen, so it never comes back

scenarios.note: 17 entries and at most 10 added a run: the top 10 by rank enter, 7 more matched and wait for the next run
the list is full at 250: nothing is added, the match waits and the list says so; nothing exits
not checked and not due change nothing: no event, misses unchanged
grace until the end of the day: a miss at 11:00 and no hit until the last run exits at the last run
a first miss at the last run is the end of the day: it exits
a hit before the last run puts it back, and a hit at the last run keeps it
a run at the end of the day that could not be judged leaves it missing; the next day's first judged miss exits it, because that miss is from an earlier day
and the next day's first judged hit puts it back
a miss on a new day is a new first miss: forgiven until that day's last run
a pinned row does not leave at the end of the day either
two screens on one list: one lets go of it and it stays while the other holds it
the owner put it in the list by hand: the screen's exit leaves it there

steps.note: not added by the screener: never removed

scenarios.note: grace never: a miss never takes it out, however many; a hit puts it back
grace of one run: the first miss exits it
grace of three runs: the third miss exits it, not the second
only judged runs count: a gap between two misses does not make a third
the counters: hits are consecutive, misses are consecutive, a miss ends a run of hits
the screen's version is the one the row was last judged at
a row the results do not name is left as it is
a hit with no rank and no price still enters; the row keeps no figures it was not given
pin works on a member only
a row that has exited or been dismissed cannot be pinned
unpinned, a row has the grace again from the misses it already has
unpinned and matching again: back in without a fuss
dismissed by the owner on the screener page: out of the list, kept out while it matches, restored it can enter again
dismiss and restore refuse what they do not apply to
a missing member can be dismissed too, and starts its grace over
an add that has not happened yet is not a removal by the owner
the owner removes a pinned member: dismissed, and no longer pinned
the owner puts a dismissed instrument back by hand: it is his, and the next match is an ordinary entry
an instrument the screen let go of that the owner then removes is not a dismissal
an exit is removed from the list once, and a removal the owner got to first is not a dismissal
the owner's own items are never touched, whatever the screen does

steps.note: the list also holds two items of his

scenarios.note: the lowest first when the screen ranks from the lowest; what has no rank comes last
the highest first, floats and whole numbers together, unranked last by symbol
equal ranks at the cut: symbol order decides, and the one left over waits
a rank of zero is a rank, and a negative one ranks below it
an instrument already in the list costs the list nothing: no limit, no room needed
why matches wait: the list had room for fewer than the screen may add
or the screen's own limit
no room at all: nothing enters, nothing is recorded
members that match again are not candidates: they take no room and no limit
a room count below zero is no room: nothing enters, and the list is what is full
a limit of zero or less admits nothing either
ranks are compared exactly: three that a float cannot tell apart still have an order
a run that enters one, brings one back and lets one go tells the entry first, then the rest in the order the results came
restored after missing its way back to exit: a clean slate, no misses left to count

plans.note: every kind of row against every kind of item
the list has room for two of three: the earliest entries first, the third waits for the next sync
a removal makes room in the same sync
two screens want the same instrument: it is added once
one screen let go, the other holds it
the owner's item is never removed
a dismissed instrument is taken out of the list if the screener put it there
a smaller list: capacity is a parameter
no room at all: everything wanted waits

free.note: the list as it stands and the adds on their way
a wanted instrument already in the list is counted once
a row that has exited or been dismissed wants no room
two screens' rows for one instrument are one place

reconcile.note: gone from the list: the owner removed it
an add that has not happened yet
the owner put a dismissed instrument back
dismissed on the page, not yet removed from the list
a pinned member removed by hand
an item of the owner's that the screen then matched
an exited row for an item another screen holds
a member inside its grace removed by hand starts over
the owner's item, the owner takes it out: only the belief changes
